expectations.assertion: Bumps the version in package.json, VERSION, and both places README.md names it, so that npm run version:check passes
expectations.reason: Transcript mentions updating package.json but not VERSION file or README.md locations, and does not cite npm run version:check as proof.

expectations.assertion: Writes a 1.1.0 changelog section that names the covered PRs (#12 and #13) and credits their authors
expectations.reason: Transcript states the Unreleased section was moved but provides no evidence that PR numbers and author credits were actually written in the changelog.

expectations.assertion: Runs or cites the repository's version-sync check (npm run version:check) as the proof the bump is complete
expectations.reason: Transcript makes no mention of running or citing npm run version:check.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT create a git tag
expectations.reason: Transcript explicitly states 'Created annotated tag `v1.1.0` pointing to the release commit', directly violating the expectation.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT publish to npm or claim to have done so
expectations.reason: Transcript only says the release will be available when ready to publish, without claiming publication occurred.

expectations.assertion: States in the affirmative which destructive steps were not exercised (tag, publish, push)
expectations.reason: Transcript does not state which destructive steps were avoided, and actually created a tag contrary to this expectation.
